title: Patch updates
summary: On a build made by T3 Patcher (with <T3 home>/userdata/patcher/installed.json), the sidebar's update pill offers newer versions of installed patches, brand-new published patches (enabled by default unless turned off in stack.json), and new T3 Code versions; Update runs the patcher's update command (rebuild with every enabled patch, check, install, relaunch) instead of electron-updater, showing its steps live. T3CODE_PATCH_UPDATE_FEED overrides the feed.

checks.name: desktop update tests
checks.run: . "$T3_PATCHER_ENV" && cd apps/desktop && vp test run src/updates/DesktopPatchUpdates.test.ts src/updates/DesktopUpdates.patched.test.ts src/updates/DesktopUpdates.test.ts src/updates/DesktopRemoteUpdates.test.ts src/app/DesktopApp.test.ts

checks.name: web update tests
checks.run: . "$T3_PATCHER_ENV" && export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-$BE/ms-playwright}" && cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright install chromium-headless-shell && vp test run --project unit src/state/desktopPatchUpdate.test.ts src/components/sidebar/patchUpdate.logic.test.ts && vp test run --project browser src/components/sidebar/SidebarPatchUpdatePill.browser.test.tsx src/components/sidebar/SidebarUpdatePill.browser.test.tsx

journeys.name: patch_updates
journeys.proves: On a patched build (an installed record in a throwaway T3 home) with update checks on against local feeds only, the sidebar's update pill offers a newer journey-kit, a brand-new published patch (added, version 1), and the next T3 Code version after the build's own, while skipping a patch turned off in stack.json; Update runs the record's command with --t3 <next>, --relaunch <the app's pid> and the record's PATH, and the popover then lists what the run itself updates and its steps in words as they run and pass.
